turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm putting together music for my friend's going away party and I have a few ideas.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait until I've listed everything before you jump in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is a playlist of all the songs from our college years, really nostalgic.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is hiring a local band that plays covers, but that eats up half the budget.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could ask a friend who does DJ sets on weekends, he'd do it for free if we feed him.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The college playlist is a sweet touch, it'll get everyone singing along. A live band is memorable, but half the budget is a lot. Your DJ friend sounds like a great deal, especially if he can mix in some of those college songs.
